newsitem.title: USA: AMERICAN FOOTBALL-FLORIDA VOTED TOP COLLEGE TEAM.
newsitem.headline: AMERICAN FOOTBALL-FLORIDA VOTED TOP COLLEGE TEAM.

text.p: Florida's demolition of
arch-rival Florida State in Thursday night's Sugar Bowl lifted
the Gators to the national college football championship.
Florida, who thumped previously top-ranked and unbeaten
Florida State 52-20 in their New Orleans showdown, jumped from
third to the top of the heap in the final coaches poll and in
the poll of sports writers and broadcasters.
The Gators improved to 12-1 for the season and avenged a
24-21 to Florida State on November 30. The Seminoles finished
their season at 11-1.
The only other previously unbeaten major team, Arizona
State, was also a bowl season loser, falling to Ohio State
20-17 in the Rose Bowl on New Year's Day.
Both polls agreed on the same top 10 list.
1. Florida (12-1)
2. Ohio State (11-1)
3. Florda State (11-1)
4. Arizona State (11-1)
5. Brigham Young (14-1)
6. Nebraska (11-2)
7. Penn State (11-2)
8. Colorado (10-2)
9. Tennessee (10-2)
10. North Carolina (10-2)
